id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1900: "Welcome to Arboria, holy land and village of the god-tellers. We have waited here for years for the Luminary's visit.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19f4: "Some buildings here hold books about ancient myths, so please do stop by.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b14: "This child is so small, yet lost his family to the shock when Yggdrasil fell, and is all alone.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1be4: "I raised children long ago, but from now on I mean to be a parent to him.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ce0: "This child is tormented by nightmares every night... He still frets over the day Yggdrasil fell and his family died.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1de0: "I can't do anything when a child is suffering. Can someone like me be a parent...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1eb8: "Throwing away one's life for someone may be a brave act. But it's too cruel to call it a beautiful tale...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fd8: "This child lost his family to the shock when the Dark One was born... He's had nightmares every night since.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20dc: "No matter how much you cry, the dead don't return. Those left behind can only slowly build a new life over time...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2220: "Since the Dark One's birth, many lives have been lost... We don't know if we'll live to see tomorrow, or if peace will come.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2440: "Since the Dark One's birth, many lives have been lost... We don't know if we'll live to see tomorrow, or if peace will come.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|231c: "...Still, while surviving lives remain, we can think of tomorrow. We will survive, I assure you.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|253c: "...Still, while surviving lives remain, we can think of tomorrow. We will survive, I assure you.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2660: "Lately my child has fewer nightmares while sleeping. His heart seems to be settling at last.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|274c: "But lately he mumbles in his sleep... I'm hard of hearing and can't make it out. What dream could he be having...?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2854: "What a suspicious dance... But if this child is enjoying it, that alone makes me happy.

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3108: "Luminary. I've heard about you. You're traveling toward Yggdrasil, I hear.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31b0: "Past this holy land of Arboria lies a mystical place, the First Forest. Go there and you can see Yggdrasil up close.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32fc: "The priest before me passed away... Now I fill in, recalling when I was a priest. Phew...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3474: "Yggdrasil, fallen to earth and decaying... May the soul of our kin Veronica rest in a peaceful place...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3578: "We're all fated to be called to Yggdrasil someday. Even now, let us pray Veronica's soul is saved. Now then...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3720: "Another sprout has scattered... How many funerals since Yggdrasil fell...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37e4: "I took on this job in place of the late priest, but I can't get used to funerals. Now then...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3904: "Ah, Luminary. Please offer a prayer for Yggdrasil and Veronica...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a24: "Veronica's wish surely protects your journey. I pray for your fortune. Now then...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cac: "Oh, what's wrong, Luminary? You have a strange look, as if waking from a long dream.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d68: "You're heading to Yggdrasil now, aren't you? Elder Fanard and your companions were looking for you.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e7c: "Ah, {var:1}. I heard you were separated from your companions, but it seems you met again safely.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f00: "You have important duties ahead, so take care not to lose your dear companions.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4010: "Ah, Luminary. I hear you're traveling after a newly appeared disturbance.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40b4: "All I can do is pray for your safety... Please, all of you, return safely.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4388: "The sacred mark on the Luminary's hand is said to be the one bond between Yggdrasil and the Luminary.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4468: "When you reach the heart of Yggdrasil, that mark will surely show you new guidance.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|55bc: "When you reach the heart of Yggdrasil, that mark will surely show you new guidance.

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4594: "The couple above these stairs lost their newborn baby to the effects of Yggdrasil's fall.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4690: "Since then they only watch the view from the terrace beside the inn... I'm too sorry for them to find words.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|47ac: "The twin sages set out in the first place to protect the Luminary...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4848: "Both may have been prepared for one to become a shield in need. But those left behind...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|494c: "In this house live a child who lost his family and a lady who lost her child. I help with their chores now and then.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4a58: "Houses where the whole family is still together have become rare in this village... Surely other towns are the same...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b5c: "To people of this village, Veronica was not just a mage bearing destiny, but always the center of everyone.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d84: "To people of this village, Veronica was not just a mage bearing destiny, but always the center of everyone.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c40: "We of Arboria will hand down Veronica's final moments forever, and keep praying for her soul's rest.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e68: "We of Arboria will hand down Veronica's final moments forever, and keep praying for her soul's rest.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4fac: "Oh! Luminary who saved the world! The star of the feast, where are you going?! Come back, come back!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5080: "If you want to leave Arboria, leave from the village entrance!

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5364: "Oh... You're the Luminary, right? You were headed to the cathedral. Why are you alone?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5400: "Everyone must be worried. Please return to the cathedral.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|58fc: "The Luminary's star is the Luminary's symbol... That it fell can't be good news.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|59b8: "I can't know what destiny awaits, but I pray for the Luminary's safety.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5ca8: "When you gaze at the night sky, do you know there's one star that shines especially bright and red?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5d64: "That is the Luminary's star... A holy star we've worshipped since ancient times as the Luminary's symbol.

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6078: "Luminary... You are the last hope of all living things in the world.

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6124: "There were far too many misfortunes, but that the Luminary's life leaf didn't scatter was a blessing in disguise...

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6418: "Veronica and Serena were never apart, not for a moment, since childhood.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|649c: "So when Serena came back and Veronica wasn't with her, I had a bad feeling...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|659c: "Veronica and Serena's parents wailed throughout the funeral...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|662c: "After the funeral they staggered home, but they're probably not in a state to rest... Please leave them be.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|674c: "I've witnessed it many times, but a funeral for someone younger than myself is painful to even watch...

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8180: "The large statue overlooking this village depicts Sage Senya, who fought beside the Luminary in ancient times.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8278: "In this ravaged world, Senya and {var:1} are our emotional support...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8378: "Just now the Elder went to the cathedral, saying he had important matters to tell the Luminary.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8448: "Please go to the Elder. The cathedral is up these stairs.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8550: "Oh, Luminary... You look very tired. Please do get some rest.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|85e4: "I believe the Elder arranged a night at the inn for you. Ask at the inn.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|870c: "The hair offered to the candelabra at a funeral is a last gift to the departed, offered in hopes of reaching Yggdrasil.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|882c: "The length of hair offered is the length of one's love... Lovers or spouses parted by death sometimes cut theirs very short.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|89e4: "Oh? Serena, you cut your hair so short. For a moment I didn't know who you were.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8a98: "Do I look that different? Being stared at like this is a little embarrassing.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8b30: "But... you'd been growing it to braid it like Veronica someday, hadn't you?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8bbc: "Yes... but it's fine. Sister and I became one in my heart.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8c98: "Yggdrasil and Senya's statue have been ruined so cruelly... But we have no time to cry.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8d60: "The Luminary's life that Veronica carried on... As long as that hope remains, we can't voice weakness.

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|119a: "It may be too much for you, still young, but please protect our daughters.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11aa: "Ah, Serena... I'm relieved to see you well, but where is Veronica?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11b3: "Those two, together since birth, being apart unsettles me. I hope she's safe...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11c5: "Uuu... aaah...! That only a staff remains... Veronica, how painful it must have been...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11ce: "If this were to happen, I wish she'd never received the oracle to be a great sage... I wanted her to live as an ordinary girl...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11e7: "Years ago, Elder Fanard found two crying babies side by side under a tree in the Silent Forest.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11f7: "We, long childless, took in the two babies, Veronica and Serena, and raised them as our own.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1207: "The Elder said he felt a strange power in the girls. He was certain they were Senya's reincarnation...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1213: "But that didn't matter to us. We raised them dearly, wanting them to simply be happy...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1221: "And yet this has happened... Veronica... sob...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1231: "Serena... You'll still go with the Luminary. We're worried about you.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|123c: "I'm sorry... I'll worry you, Father and Mother, but I have a mission I must fulfill.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1247: "I see. Do as you wish, Serena. You were always gentle, but never changed your mind once it was made.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1253: "But... you must return alive. Protect everyone and yourself too. Serena, you can do it, can't you?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1261: "Yes... I won't let anyone die before my eyes again. Thank you, Mother.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|126f: "Serena is no child anymore, so if she wants to accompany the Luminary, I won't stop her.

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|187a: "After that I grieved over the false rumors about you, but you survived... thank goodness...!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|188d: "Sixteen years ago, when Yggdrasil was wrapped in light, the Elder announced the legendary Luminary was born...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|189d: "Since then, for sixteen years, we prayed for a Luminary whose face we had never seen.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18a8: "To us the Luminary is like a child of this village. I pray for your safe journey...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18b7: "Even this holy land of Arboria is being swallowed by unclean air each day. Must we only wait for ruin...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18c8: "Veronica's parents are pitiable, but I feel even sorrier for Serena at the funeral.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18d5: "Sisters who were so close, yet she couldn't even cry, caring for her parents... How great must her grief be...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18e7: "I'd like Veronica's grave built in the forest southwest of the village.

tm.「神語りの里 聖地ラムダへ ようこそ。\n 私たちは この地で 何年もの間\n: "Welcome to Arboria, holy land and village of the god-tellers. We have waited here for years for the Luminary's visit.
tm.「この里にある 建物の中には\n 古い神話に関わる書物も ありますから\n どう: "Some buildings here hold books about ancient myths, so please do stop by.
tm.「この子は まだ 小さいのに\n 大樹が落ちた時の衝撃で 家族を亡くして\n ひ: "This child is so small, yet lost his family to the shock when Yggdrasil fell, and is all alone.
tm.「子育てなんて ずいぶん前にしたきりですが\n これからは 私が この子の\n: "I raised children long ago, but from now on I mean to be a parent to him.
tm.「この子は 毎晩 悪夢にうなされていて……。\n 命の大樹が落ちて 家族が死んだ: "This child is tormented by nightmares every night... He still frets over the day Yggdrasil fell and his family died.
tm.「子供がつらい時に 何もできないなんて\n こんな私に 親代わりが\n つとまる: "I can't do anything when a child is suffering. Can someone like me be a parent...
tm.「誰かのために 命を投げうつのは\n たしかに 勇気ある行為かもしれません。\n: "Throwing away one's life for someone may be a brave act. But it's too cruel to call it a beautiful tale...
tm.「この子は 魔王が誕生した時に\n 辺り一帯を襲った衝撃で 家族を失って……。\: "This child lost his family to the shock when the Dark One was born... He's had nightmares every night since.
tm.「どれだけ泣いても 亡くなった人は戻りません。\n 残された者が すこしずつ 時: "No matter how much you cry, the dead don't return. Those left behind can only slowly build a new life over time...
tm.「魔王の誕生以来 多くの命が失われました……。\n 明日 生きていられるのかどう: "Since the Dark One's birth, many lives have been lost... We don't know if we'll live to see tomorrow, or if peace will come.
tm.「……それでも 生き残った命が ある限り\n 明日を 考えることができます。\n: "...Still, while surviving lives remain, we can think of tomorrow. We will survive, I assure you.
tm.「最近 うちの子 眠っている時に\n 悪夢でうなされることが 少なくなったんです: "Lately my child has fewer nightmares while sleeping. His heart seems to be settling at last.
tm.「だけど 最近 寝言をつぶやいていて……。\n 耳が遠くて よく聞こえないのです: "But lately he mumbles in his sleep... I'm hard of hearing and can't make it out. What dream could he be having...?
tm.「何やら 怪しげな踊りだねえ……。\n でも この子が楽しそうにしてるなら\n: "What a suspicious dance... But if this child is enjoying it, that alone makes me happy.
tm.「勇者さま。お話は聞きましたぞ。\n 命の大樹を目指して 旅をしているそうですな: "Luminary. I've heard about you. You're traveling toward Yggdrasil, I hear.
tm.「この 聖地ラムダを抜けた先にある\n 神秘の場所……始祖の森へと進めば\n 命: "Past this holy land of Arboria lies a mystical place, the First Forest. Go there and you can see Yggdrasil up close.
tm.「前にいた神父は 亡くなってしまってのう……。\n 今は わしが 神父だった頃を: "The priest before me passed away... Now I fill in, recalling when I was a priest. Phew...
tm.「地に落ちて 朽ちつつある 命の大樹よ……。\n 願わくば 我らの同胞 ベロニカ: "Yggdrasil, fallen to earth and decaying... May the soul of our kin Veronica rest in a peaceful place...
tm.「皆 いつかは 命の大樹のもとへ召される定め。\n 大樹が落ちた今も ベロニカの: "We're all fated to be called to Yggdrasil someday. Even now, let us pray Veronica's soul is saved. Now then...
tm.「また 若芽が散っていきおったか……。\n 命の大樹が落ちてから これで\n 何: "Another sprout has scattered... How many funerals since Yggdrasil fell...
tm.「亡くなった神父の 代わりに\n この仕事を してみたものの\n 葬儀は 慣れん: "I took on this job in place of the late priest, but I can't get used to funerals. Now then...
tm.「おぉ 勇者さま。\n 命の大樹と ベロニカのために\n どうか 祈りを捧げてい: "Ah, Luminary. Please offer a prayer for Yggdrasil and Veronica...
tm.「勇者さまの旅路は ベロニカの願いで\n 護られていることでしょう。\n ご武運: "Veronica's wish surely protects your journey. I pray for your fortune. Now then...
tm.「おや どうされました 勇者さま。\n 何やら 長い夢から覚めたような\n 不思: "Oh, what's wrong, Luminary? You have a strange look, as if waking from a long dream.
tm.「これから 命の大樹へ向かわれるのでしょう。\n ファナード長老や お仲間が\n: "You're heading to Yggdrasil now, aren't you? Elder Fanard and your companions were looking for you.
tm.「おお {var:1}さま。\n お仲間と はぐれたと聞きましたが\n 無事に: "Ah, {var:1}. I heard you were separated from your companions, but it seems you met again safely.
tm.「これから 大事な役目があるのでしょうから\n 大切な お仲間と はぐれないよう: "You have important duties ahead, so take care not to lose your dear companions.
tm.「おお 勇者さま。\n なにやら 新たに現れた異変を追って\n 旅を されている: "Ah, Luminary. I hear you're traveling after a newly appeared disturbance.
tm.「わしには ただ 勇者さまの安全を\n 祈ることしか できませぬが……。\n ど: "All I can do is pray for your safety... Please, all of you, return safely.
tm.「勇者さまの手に宿る 聖なる紋章は\n 命の大樹と 勇者をつなぐ\n ただひとつ: "The sacred mark on the Luminary's hand is said to be the one bond between Yggdrasil and the Luminary.
tm.「命の大樹の中心にたどり着いた時\n きっと その紋章が あなたに\n 新たな導: "When you reach the heart of Yggdrasil, that mark will surely show you new guidance.
tm.「この階段の上にいる ご夫婦は\n 命の大樹が 落ちた時の影響で\n 生まれたば: "The couple above these stairs lost their newborn baby to the effects of Yggdrasil's fall.
tm.「それ以来 ずっと 宿屋のとなりのテラスで\n 景色を 見ているばかりで……。\: "Since then they only watch the view from the terrace beside the inn... I'm too sorry for them to find words.
tm.「双賢の姉妹が旅に出たのは そもそも\n 勇者さまを お守りするため……。: "The twin sages set out in the first place to protect the Luminary...
tm.「いざという時 どちらかが盾になることは\n ふたりとも 覚悟していたのかもしれ: "Both may have been prepared for one to become a shield in need. But those left behind...
tm.「この家では 家族を失った子供と\n 子供を失った婦人が 暮らしていましてね。\: "In this house live a child who lost his family and a lady who lost her child. I help with their chores now and then.
tm.「もう 家族みんながそろっているという家は\n この里では めずらしくなりました: "Houses where the whole family is still together have become rare in this village... Surely other towns are the same...
tm.「ベロニカは……この里の者にとって\n ただ 宿命を負う魔法使いというだけではな: "To people of this village, Veronica was not just a mage bearing destiny, but always the center of everyone.
tm.「我ら 聖地ラムダの者は\n ベロニカの最期を 永遠に 語り継ぎ……\n そして: "We of Arboria will hand down Veronica's final moments forever, and keep praying for her soul's rest.
tm.「おお！ 世界を救った 勇者どの！\n 宴の主役が どこに行こうってんです！？\: "Oh! Luminary who saved the world! The star of the feast, where are you going?! Come back, come back!
tm.「もしも ラムダから出たかったら\n 里の入り口の方から 出てくだせえ！: "If you want to leave Arboria, leave from the village entrance!
tm.「勇者さまの手に宿る 聖なる紋章は\n 命の大樹と 勇者をつなぐ\n ただひとつ: "The sacred mark on the Luminary's hand is said to be the one bond between Yggdrasil and the Luminary.
tm.「命の大樹の中心に たどり着いた時\n きっと その紋章が あなたに\n 新たな: "When you reach the heart of Yggdrasil, that mark will surely show you new guidance.
tm.「おや……勇者さまですよね？\n たしか 大聖堂へ向かわれたはずなのに\n おひ: "Oh... You're the Luminary, right? You were headed to the cathedral. Why are you alone?
tm.「きっと みんな 心配していますよ。\n 大聖堂の方へ お戻りくださいませ。: "Everyone must be worried. Please return to the cathedral.
tm.「勇者の星は 勇者さまの象徴……。\n それが 落ちてしまったということは\n: "The Luminary's star is the Luminary's symbol... That it fell can't be good news.
tm.「どのような宿命が 待ちうけているのかは\n 私は 知るよしもありませんが……。: "I can't know what destiny awaits, but I pray for the Luminary's safety.
tm.「夜に 星空を ながめていると\n ひとつ ひときわ明るくかがやく\n 赤い星が: "When you gaze at the night sky, do you know there's one star that shines especially bright and red?
tm.「あれこそは 勇者の星……。\n 古来より 私たちが 勇者さまの象徴として\n: "That is the Luminary's star... A holy star we've worshipped since ancient times as the Luminary's symbol.
tm.「こうして 夜空を見上げていると\n ひとつ ひときわ明るくかがやく\n 赤い星: "Looking up at the night sky like this, can you see one star shining especially bright and red?
tm.「あれなるは 勇者の星……。\n 古来より 私たちが 勇者さまの象徴として\n: "That is the Luminary's star... A holy star we've worshipped since ancient times as the Luminary's symbol.
tm.「勇者さま……。\n あなたは 世界中の生きとし生けるもの\n すべてにとっての: "Luminary... You are the last hope of all living things in the world.
tm.「あまりに 多くの不幸がありましたが\n 勇者さまの命の葉が 散らずにいたのは\: "There were far too many misfortunes, but that the Luminary's life leaf didn't scatter was a blessing in disguise...
tm.「ベロニカとセーニャは 子供の頃から\n かたときも 離れることがありませんでし: "Veronica and Serena were never apart, not for a moment, since childhood.
tm.「ですから セーニャが戻ってきても\n ベロニカの姿が 見えなかった時から\n: "So when Serena came back and Veronica wasn't with her, I had a bad feeling...
tm.「ベロニカとセーニャの両親は\n 葬儀が終わるまで ずっと\n 泣きさけんでおり: "Veronica and Serena's parents wailed throughout the funeral...
tm.「葬儀が終わると フラフラと 家に戻りましたが\n おそらく 休める状態ではない: "After the funeral they staggered home, but they're probably not in a state to rest... Please leave them be.
tm.「もう 何度も立ち会った光景ではありますが\n 自分よりも 若い者の葬儀は\n: "I've witnessed it many times, but a funeral for someone younger than myself is painful to even watch...
tm.「魔王が誕生した時の衝撃で ベロニカの他にも\n 多くの 若い命が亡くなりました: "The shock when the Dark One was born killed many young lives besides Veronica. I can only pray they rest in peace...
tm.「どくけしそうを煎じた お茶……。\n みんなは 渋くてマズイと言いますが\n: "Tea brewed from antidotal herbs... Everyone says it's bitter and awful, but drink it daily and it grows on you.
tm.「世界も平和になったことですし\n ラムダの里 自慢の どくけし茶として売って\: "Now that the world's at peace, maybe we could sell it as Arboria's proud antidote tea and trade with other towns.
tm.「勇者の星が 見えなくなるなんて……。\n これは いったい なんの予兆なのでし: "The Luminary's star disappearing... What omen is this? Oh... I can't stop trembling...
tm.「この里を見下ろす 大きな彫像は\n いにしえの勇者さまと 一緒に戦った\n あ: "The large statue overlooking this village depicts a sage who fought beside the Luminary of ancient times.
tm.「この里に伝わる 数多くの神話や伝承……\n その中でも 特に大事にされているの: "Among this village's many myths and legends, those about the ancient Luminary are cherished most.
tm.「私の 気のせいかしら……。\n 今日の賢者さま ちょっと\n 笑っているような: "Is it just me... The sage looks like she's smiling a little today.
tm.「里の奥にある 大聖堂には その\n いにしえの勇者さまの 伝説を描いた\n 聖: "In the cathedral at the back of the village, a sacred painting of the ancient Luminary's legend is enshrined.
tm.「この里を見下ろす 大きな彫像は\n いにしえの時代 勇者さまと共に戦ったという: "The large statue overlooking this village depicts Sage Senya, who fought beside the Luminary in ancient times.
tm.「こんな 荒んだ世界になってしまった今は\n セニカさまと {var:1}さまが: "In this ravaged world, Senya and {var:1} are our emotional support...
tm.「先ほど 長老さまが\n 勇者さまに 大事な話があると言って\n 大聖堂へ 向か: "Just now the Elder went to the cathedral, saying he had important matters to tell the Luminary.
tm.「どうか 長老さまの所へ向かってくださいませ。\n 大聖堂は こちらの階段を上っ: "Please go to the Elder. The cathedral is up these stairs.
tm.「まあ 勇者さま……。\n ずいぶん 疲れたカオをしていますわ。\n どうか お: "Oh, Luminary... You look very tired. Please do get some rest.
tm.「たしか 長老さまが 宿を一泊\n 勇者さまのために 用意していましたわ。\n: "I believe the Elder arranged a night at the inn for you. Ask at the inn.
tm.「葬儀の時に 燭台へ手向ける髪は\n 命の大樹のもとへ届くことを願い 捧げられる: "The hair offered to the candelabra at a funeral is a last gift to the departed, offered in hopes of reaching Yggdrasil.
tm.「捧げる髪の長さは 思いの丈の長さ……。\n 深く愛し合った恋人や 夫婦が死に別: "The length of hair offered is the length of one's love... Lovers or spouses parted by death sometimes cut theirs very short.
tm.「あら？ セーニャったら ずいぶん\n バッサリと 髪を切ってしまったのね。\n: "Oh? Serena, you cut your hair so short. For a moment I didn't know who you were.
tm.「そんなに 印象が ちがいますか？\n 改めて まじまじと見られると\n ちょっ: "Do I look that different? Being stared at like this is a little embarrassing.
tm.「でも……いつか ベロニカと同じ\n 三つ編みにしたくて 伸ばしていたんでしょう: "But... you'd been growing it to braid it like Veronica someday, hadn't you?
tm.「ええ……でも いいんです。\n お姉さまとは 私の心の中で\n ひとつに なれ: "Yes... but it's fine. Sister and I became one in my heart.
tm.「命の大樹も セニカさまの像も\n 無残なことに なってしまいました……。\n: "Yggdrasil and Senya's statue have been ruined so cruelly... But we have no time to cry.
tm.「ベロニカがつないだ 勇者さまの命……。\n その希望が この世にある限り\n: "The Luminary's life that Veronica carried on... As long as that hope remains, we can't voice weakness.
tm.「ダ ダンスなんて したことないから\n なんだか はずかしいですわ……。\n: "I've never danced, so this is embarrassing... Is this right? Here, hup!
tm.「まあ {var:1}さま……。\n なにやら まがまがしく 凶悪な剣を\n お: "Oh, {var:1}... You carry a sinister, wicked sword...
tm.「それに {var:1}さま自身も\n 前に見た時より 雰囲気が変わりましたわ。: "And you yourself have changed since I last saw you. You seem stronger somehow...
tm.「あら 私の気のせいかしら……。\n 今日の賢者さま なんだか\n 悲しそうなカ: "Oh, is it my imagination... The sage looks a bit sad today.
tm.「私は ずいぶん前に 結婚したのですが\n なかなか 子宝に恵まれなくて……\n: "I married long ago, but we weren't blessed with children... Honestly, I'd given up on a child.
tm.「でも つい先日 待望の我が子が\n やっと 生まれてくれたんです！\n うれし: "But just the other day our long-awaited child was finally born! I'm so happy! Truly happy!
tm.「あまり 思いつめないほうがいい……。\n 僕たちは あの子を助けるために\n: "Don't brood so much... We did our very best to save that child...
